meta.name: mass-ulw
meta.description: Drives dependency-ordered child work through the native workflow tool, one run per phase with retry/amend/send recovery. Use when the user asks for mass-ulw, a DAG of tasks, or fan-out work where some tasks must wait on others.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 调度一批互相依赖的子任务,按阶段依次执行,失败自动重试补救
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要让一大批有先后依赖的任务分成多个子任务按序跑完
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you must fan out many interdependent tasks across child workers in order

howto.what: 它把有先后依赖的多智能体任务定义成节点图,按依赖分批并行执行;节点失败可单独重试、追加消息或修订定义,会话中断后能续跑。
howto.when: 当你要求 mass-ulw、任务 DAG 或分批 fan-out,或某些任务必须等前置任务完成时触发。

say.text: 用 mass-ulw 跑 docs-refresh 这个 DAG
say.note: 先读规划文档,再定义并启动 run

say.text: 重试 lint 节点,提示改成跳过 vendored 目录
say.note: 只对该节点发起新一次尝试

say.text: 给正在跑的 lint 节点发消息:跳过 vendored 目录

howto.what_en: It turns dependency-ordered multi-agent work into a node graph, running each phase as one run in parallel waves; a failed node can be retried, sent a message, or amended, and paused runs resume after a restart.
howto.when_en: Use when the user asks for mass-ulw, a task DAG, or staged fan-out where some tasks must wait on others.

say_en.text: Run the docs-refresh DAG with mass-ulw
say_en.note: Reads planning.md, then defines and starts the run

say_en.text: Retry the lint node with a prompt that skips the vendored dir
say_en.note: Only that node gets a fresh attempt

say_en.text: Send the running lint node: skip the vendored dir
